text.offer: Queen Venya'cyr's city of Brax lies buried under the Cragged Mountains, and from it the dead rise to trouble my people. My mages tell of a ghost in those mountains, the druid Tendrath, who has watched over Brax for an age. Seek him out; he will know how to enter.
text.progress: Tendrath haunts the Cragged Mountains, outside the ancient place where Brax lies buried.
text.complete: The Princess has sent you? Then the crown remembers Brax. Good. I have waited long for help.

steps.objective: Find Tendrath in the Cragged Mountains
